purpose: Assemble the verified normal job tree and skill-acquisition outputs into per-hero basic-combat records, emit evidence-backed partial data for all canonical heroes, and keep unresolved display semantics explicitly blocked instead of fabricating values.

awakening.evidence: dump.cs explicitly names HeroInfo.Awaken_ID field 50 and ConfigDataAwakenInfo.Level2SkillID field 9. The restored ConfigDataAwakenInfo payload passes structural preflight and is now used to resolve per-hero awakening skills.

jobLevelStatComponents.evidence: dump.cs explicitly defines the twelve JobLevelInfo INI/UP stat fields. They are raw progression components, not the final hero-page display values.

talentReferenceSet.evidence: JobConnectionInfo.TalentSkill_IDs is explicit and Stage 4-4 resolves every referenced ID to SkillInfo. Stage 4-5 preserves the per-connection talent-skill set without inventing the star-rank selection rule.

semanticGates.requiredEvidence: ConfigDataAwakenInfo is structurally usable and each nonzero HeroInfo.Awaken_ID can be resolved through AwakenInfo.Level2SkillID to SkillInfo.

Recover or independently validate the HeroPropertyComputer calculation used for the hero-page HP/ATK/INT/DEF/MDEF/SKL display values. ComputeHeroProperties accepts hero, JobConnection, hero level, star level, JobLevel and SP stage; raw JobLevel INI/UP or JobInfo BattlePower fields must not be published as final values by themselves.
Verify the source/calculation for the hero-page soldier HP/ATK/DEF/MDEF modifier percentages. SoldierInfo base stats and TrainingTech values are not substitutes.
No further evidence is required to preserve the JobConnection TalentSkill_IDs set itself. A separate gate still controls which variant is displayed at each star rank.
Verify how hero star rank selects or orders the TalentSkill_IDs variants. HeroInfo.Star, HeroStarInfo upgrade costs, or array position alone are insufficient.

normalizationRules: Consume Stage 4-3 and Stage 4-4 only when their status is PASS or REVIEW.
Use heroId as the only canonical hero join key.
Preserve Stage 4-3 topology and Stage 4-4 acquisition order exactly.
Emit partial records for all upstream heroes when required sources are healthy even if final display semantics remain blocked.
Attach the twelve verified JobLevelInfo INI/UP fields as raw stat components only; never label them final display stats.
Preserve Stage 4-4 connectionTalentSkills as the verified talent reference set; do not assign star-rank labels until the selection rule is verified.
Read HeroInfo.Awaken_ID directly and resolve the awakening skill through the restored ConfigDataAwakenInfo payload.
Do not infer awakening from skill ID, name, cost, job rank, or wiki order.
Do not substitute SoldierInfo/TrainingTech values for hero soldier modifiers.
Keep unresolved final fields null with a component status and evidence note instead of suppressing the entire 267-hero record set.

UPSTREAM_BLOCKED: Stage 4-3 or Stage 4-4 is missing or has a status other than PASS/REVIEW.
SOURCE_BLOCKED: Any required source is missing or structurally invalid.
FAIL: Stage 4-3 and Stage 4-4 hero sets disagree.
A Stage 4-3 JobLevel ID is missing from the restored JobLevelInfo source.
A nonzero awakening relation resolves to a missing AwakenInfo/SkillInfo record.
Duplicate IDs make a verified relation ambiguous.
SEMANTIC_BLOCKED: Partial records are generated, but one or more final-display semantic gates remain unresolved.
PASS: 267 basic-combat records are generated and every final-display semantic gate is verified and populated without inferred relationships.

stage4CompletionRule: Stage 4 is data-complete only when Stage 4-5 returns PASS. A 267-record SEMANTIC_BLOCKED output is a valid partial reconstruction, not final page-ready combat data.
completionRule: Run npm run inspect:hero-combat. Awakening is now source-verified; separately verify the final-stat, soldier-modifier and talent-star selection rules before promoting Stage 4-5 to PASS.
nextStage: 5-1 bond data can be implemented in parallel, but Stage 6 must not treat Stage 4 as data-complete until Stage 4-5 PASS.
